name: Install a binary from GitHub releases

token.description: GITHUB_TOKEN or a `repo` scoped Personal Access Token (PAT)

repo.description: GitHub repo where binary is located

digest.description: SHA256 digest of the release asset. Specify this parameter to verify the integrity of the downloaded asset.

platform.description: OS Platform to match in release package. Specify this parameter if the repository releases do not follow a normal convention otherwise it will be auto-detected.

arch.description: OS Architecture to match in release package. Specify this parameter if the repository releases do not follow a normal convention otherwise it will be auto-detec

extension.description: Custom file extension to match in release package.  Specify this parameter if the repository releases do not provide a .tar.gz or .zip format release.

extension-matching.description: Enable/disable file extension matching in release package.  Specify this parameter if the repository releases do not have a file extension e.g. they are pure bi

rename-to.description: When installing a release that is not an archive, e.g. a pure binary, this controls how the downloaded release asset is renamed.  Specify this parameter if inst

chmod.description: When installing a release that is not an archive, e.g. a pure binary, this controls how the downloaded release asset is chmod'd.  Specify this parameter if inst

cache.description: When set to 'enable', caches the downloads of known tags with actions/cache

binaries-location.description: Specify this parameter if the binaries are not located in the root of the release archive. The parameter should be a relative path to the release archive. For e

asset-name.description: Use this parameter to specify the name of the asset to download if the repo has multiple assets.
